dialogues.speaker: Beryna
dialogues.text: Nothing like good fresh bread to raise everyone's morale...

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: Ah, are you referring to "Mushroom Phantasm"? Hehe, it's a big hit.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: Everyone loved it. They said it's been really long since they've tasted something so comforting. Even Mr. Marushkin and Miss Gabieta looked a little more relaxed... At least, I thought so?

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: I was able to make it successfully thanks to your help. Thank you so much!

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: Anyway, I've been thinking — what if I made a delicious jam from sweet Sunsettias and Fontaine's Bulle Fruits, then use this jam as a substitute for the mushroom filling? Would it taste even better?

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: Not that I'd really do it. If I actually spent our Mora on Bulle Fruit of all things, Miss Gabieta would probably get so mad she'd turn redder than a Sunsettia...

choices.text: Say, why did you become a Ratnik?

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: Hmm... It's a bit of a long story...

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: I lost my parents when I was very young. The Wild Hunt killed them after they hid me away.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: I should have died there too... They may be headless, but those monsters have a terrifyingly sharp "sense of smell." I tried so hard to stay silent, but they still found me.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: That was when Mr. Sigurd saved me. Ah, Mr. Sigurd was an exceptionally skilled Lightkeeper... He's no longer with us either, though.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: He brought me back to Piramida when I had nowhere else to go. Back then, Piramida was nothing like the bustling place it is now. Barely a soul could be found within the walls of this fortress...

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: Which is why I never actually went through the rigorous screening process implemented later. At the time, there was simply no one capable of working, so anyone who applied was accepted.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: And I... I, too, hope to become someone like Mr. Sigurd, someone who can bring warmth to those around me.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: I can't fight like everyone else, but at least... I hope I can help them smile a little more easily.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: Those who watch over the light in darkness... No matter how dark it gets, they can still smile when something good happens and find joy in a delicious meal. That's how I see it.

choices.text: Do you need any further help?

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: Hehe, thank you for the concern! This place is safe now, I won't trouble you with harvesting wheat anymore.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: Still, I'm relieved to have someone as reliable as you around.

response.speaker: Beryna
response.text: Mm, safe travels! And don't forget to eat well.
